Each arc on the globe represents one full iteration of this six-stage pipeline — triggered by a signal from a source state (coral marker) arriving at a target
democracy (teal marker). Hover any stage above to see how it maps to what you are watching on the globe. The arc colour corresponds to the OSINT strategy
phase active at that moment, and the live feed panel logs each pipeline cycle as it completes.
